name: product-sheet
title: Product information review sheet
for_each: SELECT id,sku FROM products ORDER BY sku

sections.title: Product content
sections.sql: SELECT attribute,locale,channel,value FROM product_values WHERE product_id=$1 ORDER BY attribute,locale,channel

sections.title: Recorded claims
sections.note: Internal review sheet. Pending claims are not approved copy. Evidence references must be assessed by the owner.

name: content-brief
title: Supplier content request brief
for_each: SELECT id,sku FROM products WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE product_id=products.id AND status='open') ORDER BY sku

sections.title: Supplier
sections.sql: SELECT sku,name,supplier,owner FROM products WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Open requests
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due_on FROM tasks WHERE product_id=$1 AND status='open' ORDER BY due_on
